observed: E1 encoding round trips and E2 finite execution do not establish universal-in-input lowering equivalence.
The pinned Sail default property query accepts overflow and failed assumptions as escape paths; E3 must use an explicit no-escape query.
Existing lowering has memory/provenance, effects, ABI, 128-bit, floating and other forms outside the executable integer model.

scope.included: Inventory every current EvoIR Inst family, every Section 5 table row and each target patterns row, including named specialized lowering/emission paths. Give each a scoped verdict. Symbolically check the E2 nine-by-nine integer bodies and eight constant controls against the verbatim vendor model; do not claim unattempted widths or patterns.
scope.body_source: .evidence/codegen/n07-e2/corpus-linux.o; re-extract actual words with the existing E2 object parser and compare with its recorded differential. Same words exist in Darwin. Do not hand-select or simplify machine instructions.
scope.source_semantics: EvoIR sections 3.2, 3.3, 3.4: fixed-width modular add/sub/mul, Boolean bit operations, and shifts restricted to defined counts. Source values are low N bits of arbitrary 64-bit ABI inputs; results zero-extend to 64. Reference expressions use Sail bitvector primitives, never host arithmetic or handwritten ISA.
scope.state: Arbitrary initial x0/x1, all other 29 GPRs and every ProcState field. Allowed writes x0/x1 only; compare x0 to source result and preserve x2..x30 plus ProcState. No SP/memory/PC/RET/ABI proof. Model exception returns false. SEE is model bookkeeping, not architectural state.
scope.domain: Operations add/sub/mul/and/or/xor/shl/lshr/ashr at N=1,2,8,16,31,32,33,63,64. Shift count source width M=N and unsigned low-N count < N. Other widths, M!=N, poison, signed shift predicates and all wider memory/effect/ABI families receive explicit NOT_MODELLED or PARTIAL verdicts, never PASS by association.
scope.unchanged: No compiler lowering, model semantics, interpreter, registry, EqSat, option-default or native timing changes. Proof against the pinned model does not change the production trust policy.
scope.inventory: No generic opcode DSL or new audit layer. One versioned result table maps current code/spec rows to concrete obligations or explicit reasons outside this model. Negative/UNKNOWN rows remain visible.

toolchain.execution: existing sealed Linux container, serial, 2 CPUs/3 GiB, no new image/disk or toolchain build

smt.query: ~(exist assertion) & all return & ~(exist match_failure) & ~(exist overflow) & all assumption
smt.static_loop_policy: Sail fully unrolls statically bounded loops. Dynamic cutoff emits match_failure and cannot be a pass under the explicit query.
forbidden: SAT or UNKNOWN classified as proof
smt.proof_admission: Bounded pass only on exact successful solver UNSAT plus separate SAT domain non-vacuity query. Runtime is not used as proof. Preserve exact solver status, timeout, generation error and unknown separately.
controls: Wrong add/sub instruction must produce SAT.
Unexpected x2 modification must produce SAT even when x0 is correct.
Unknown instruction caught as false must produce SAT.
Overflow must not escape; a bounded unbounded-integer overflow sentinel produces SAT.
A false Sail assumption must not escape; produces SAT.
Loop cutoff cannot silently succeed; explicit match-failure query rejects it.
Deliberately empty shift domain fails the SAT non-vacuity check.
Missing/error/unknown solver output never reports a pass.

sequence: Commit plan, then RED for absent obligations and observed query/status failures.
Qualify pinned Sail/Z3 against small source/model properties and negative controls before all obligations.
Run the 89 frozen bodies without production code edits; keep per-shape symbolic domain, result and state verdicts.
Complete the existing-rule inventory with explicit scope and negative/unknown rows; no full-backend promotion.

Full workspace, focused Python and unchanged-object regressions; compact receipt and one-page note. Retire generated transient SMT after hashes where reproducible, retaining counterexamples and minimal reproducers.

acceptance.per_rule: Every inventory row has a verdict and reason. A counterexample to an admitted source/model claim becomes an isolated defect; do not silently weaken the domain.
acceptance.positive_ceiling: Universal over inputs and preserved register/ProcState components only for the frozen concrete body and width, bounded by the admitted Sail/SMT translation; not a kernel proof or theorem for the whole selector.
acceptance.partial_closure: If dependency qualification or resources prevent coverage, freeze a negative/partial scoped result and explicit missing domains, then continue other quality slices. Do not label NOT_MODELLED as proved.
acceptance.object_identity: 384 native objects per OS plus 24 A/B/profile TU objects retain two-build/full-byte identity to E2; no size gain.

resources.retention: Reuse E2 extracted toolchain and model. Preserve current native/TU baselines, contracts, fixtures and .lake. No full disassembly, workspace/kernel clone, new target or VM disk; record scoped disk increment.

claim_ceiling: Scoped model-backed bounded SMT verdicts or honest negative/partial closure; never whole-backend correctness, proof of ISA source, new Lean proof, semantic authority, default optimization admission or performance benefit.
